answer: The smoother sands the barrel head till it is silk, and the sanding must not thin the wood or the head cracks. Stave ash barrel trimmer oak bond rules the smoothing: a bond ash barrel trimmers lodge after trimming bench trials. The terrace is the first sand, rubbed at the bench; the island is the last, rubbed before the head is fitted, and the vault is the bench itself, smooth as glass. A cheat must sand 79 false heads and fit 79 false benches.
